_why: #11/H3: on HemaSuite #18 the exit streak was reset four times by legs being added and never once approached by the documents — zero at c99 when measured and still zero at c104 — while Sigma-must tracked the LEG COUNT. Each row restores one way a streak can close over two cycles that asked DIFFERENT questions, plus the two ways the calibration can invert: refusing an unrecorded leg set (a false hard fail on every pre-H3 stamp) and letting order or duplication read as a change.

mutations.name: a-changed-leg-set-no-longer-blocks-the-exit
mutations._mechanism: THE defect: the streak closes over two cycles that ran different legs, which is c92 (doc-auditor+crossdoc added) and c97 (codex returning) exactly — the reset nobody was counting.

mutations.name: an-unrecorded-leg-set-blocks-the-exit
mutations._mechanism: The calibration inverted: a hard fail fires on every stamp written before the field existed. This is the 104/49/48 error (docs/learnings.md:77) — a detector that refuses artifacts which legitimately passed. Not-blocking is the assertion here, so it gets a row. The named test is the MIXED pair, not the both-unrecorded one: two unrecorded cycles compare equal even with the guard removed, so that pair leaves the mutant alive and the battery reports it caught by the wrong assertion.
mutations.find: if first is not None and second is not None:

mutations.name: the-leg-set-is-recorded-unnormalised
mutations._mechanism: Order and duplication become leg-set changes, so the gate refuses a streak for the order the orchestrator typed its flags in — a block with no defect behind it, which is how a gate gets switched off.
mutations.find: return sorted({str(name).strip() for name in legs if str(name).strip()})

mutations.name: an-unnamed-leg-set-is-stamped-as-an-empty-list
mutations._mechanism: `[]` CLAIMS the cycle ran zero legs, so two unnamed cycles compare equal and close the exit gate on a set nobody declared — silence reaching green through the comparison instead of around it.

mutations.name: the-unrecorded-leg-set-is-not-reported-at-stamp-time
mutations._mechanism: The nudge disappears from the point of use and survives only at the exit gate, so H3 degrades into prose an orchestrator can skip — the failure mode h_mad_audit_gate.py:466 names for the streak rule itself.
mutations.find:
if legs_line is not None:
        print(f"GATE-LEGS: {legs_line}")

mutations.name: the-unrecorded-leg-set-is-not-reported-at-the-exit-gate
mutations._mechanism: A READY that closed over an unknown leg set reads identically to one that closed over a declared one. Not blocking and not saying are different things; only the second makes the field pointless.
mutations.find: line += f" legs={'+'.join(result['legs']) if result.get('legs') else 'unrecorded'}"

mutations.name: the-leg-set-is-woven-into-the-GATE-line
mutations._mechanism: `h_mad_audit_cycle.GATE_RE` anchors on `should=N\s*$`, so a fifth field on line 1 makes EVERY verdict un-parse — the same reason GATE-CLASS and SUITE are their own lines.
mutations.find:
stamped = f" gated={len(files)}"
        # Deferred, not printed here
mutations.replace:
stamped = f" gated={len(files)} legs={legs}"
        # Deferred, not printed here

mutations.name: the-leg-set-outranks-the-red-suite
mutations._mechanism: #91's refusal softened by the one added beside it: a cycle with a red suite but a matching leg set would report legs_changed=no and close. The suite check must still run first, per stamp, before anything is compared.

mutations.name: a-streak-counts-stamps-again-not-cycles
mutations._mechanism: THE new defect: two legs of ONE cycle sort adjacently and read as a two-cycle streak. Reproduced on the real archive — design.audit.v20.codex + v20.p1 returned EXIT: READY against the shipped gate.
mutations.find: order = sorted(grouped, key=lambda k: (k[0], k[1], k[2]))
mutations.replace:
order = sorted(grouped, key=lambda k: (k[0], k[1], k[2]))
    order = order + order

mutations.name: an-unplaceable-stamp-name-is-let-through
mutations._mechanism: Fail-open on cycle identity: a stamp whose cycle cannot be established is counted as its own cycle, so any two files close the gate. This is what the 2026-09-07 field tracer's A.json/B.json would have done.
mutations.find:
if key is None:
            return {"verdict": "UNREADABLE", "reason": f"stamp_name:{path.name}"}

mutations.name: cycles-are-ordered-lexically-not-numerically
mutations._mechanism: `v10` sorts before `v9` as text, so the gate considers the wrong pair and a stale failing cycle can be skipped over or a fresh clean one ignored.
mutations.find: order = sorted(grouped, key=lambda k: (k[0], k[1], k[2]))
mutations.replace: order = sorted(grouped, key=lambda k: (k[0], k[1], str(k[2])))

mutations.name: only-the-first-leg-of-a-cycle-is-scored
mutations._mechanism: A cycle with one clean leg and one dirty leg counts as clean — the per-leg reading of a rule that is about cycles.

mutations.name: legs-disagreeing-within-one-cycle-picks-a-winner
mutations._mechanism: Two legs of one cycle claiming different leg sets is a cannot-judge; silently taking the first makes the H3 comparison depend on filename order.
